contract.primary_gate: latest status wins across count, query, and reopen
contract.secondary_gate: intermediate user1 and user2 counts are zero after final deleted transition

must_hold: The fixture appends two TSDB records.
Entry 1 transitions through user1, user2, and deleted.
Final user1 and user2 counts are 0.
Query shows entry 1 as deleted and entry 2 as written.
Reopen preserves the same final visible statuses.
Schema-aware diff treats count and query entry status as strict behavior fields.
must_not_claim: native FlashDB clean or GC semantics
